question: brakes-fjord
answer:
For a complete **left-front brake replacement** on your **Voltrieve Fjord AWD**, the service guide calls for the following parts and fluid.  (voltrieve-service-guide.md)

| Qty | Part | Article number |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Left-front brake disc, 370 mm | **VP-10072** |
| 1 set | Front brake pads, for both sides of the axle | **VP-10254** |
| 1 | Left-front brake caliper | **VP-10345** |
| 1 | Left-front caliper carrier | **VP-10527** |
| 1 | Left-front brake hose | **VP-10631** |
| 1 | Left-front pad wear sensor | **VP-10670** |
| 1 | Front caliper fitting kit | **VP-10709** |
| 1 | Left-front brake dust shield | **VP-10761** |
| 1 bottle | DOT 4 LV brake fluid, 1 litre | **VP-15168** |

Article numbers are from the Voltrieve spare parts catalog.  (voltrieve-parts-brakes.md) (voltrieve-parts-brakes.md) (voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)

The pad set covers **both front wheels**; the guide says pads are renewed as an axle set even when only one side is being worked on.  (voltrieve-service-guide.md)

Before work under the car, the guide says to put it in service mode. Before lifting the Fjord, turn off automatic air-suspension levelling.  (voltrieve-service-guide.md) (voltrieve-service-guide.md)

For a complete front-left brake replacement on your Lumen, buy the parts below. **Check whether yours is RWD or AWD before ordering**: the disc, pads, caliper and carrier differ. The service guide specifies one of each item listed.  (voltrieve-service-guide.md)

| Part | Lumen RWD | Lumen AWD |
|---|---|---|
| Front-left brake disc | VP-10020, 300 mm | VP-10033, 320 mm |
| Front axle brake pad set | VP-10202 | VP-10215 |
| Front-left brake caliper | VP-10293 | VP-10306 |
| Front-left caliper carrier | VP-10475 | VP-10488 |

 (voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)

For **either drive**, also buy:

- 1 front-left brake hose - **VP-10618**
- 1 front caliper fitting kit - **VP-10696**; the kit covers one side
- 1 front-left brake dust shield - **VP-10735**
- 1 bottle of DOT 4 LV brake fluid, 1 litre - **VP-15168**  (voltrieve-parts-brakes.md) (voltrieve-parts-brakes.md)

The pad set covers **both sides of the front axle**; pads are renewed as an axle set. The Lumen has no electrical pad wear sensor.  (voltrieve-service-guide.md) (voltrieve-service-guide.md)
